# CFS Flooring LLC — Commercial & Residential Flooring Contractor

> CFS Flooring provides expert solid hardwood installation, dust-controlled sand and finish refinishing, 100% waterproof Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP), custom ceramic tile, and commercial carpet/VCT installation across the Pacific Northwest (Lake Oswego, West Linn, Wilsonville, Portland Metro, and Vancouver WA).

## Core Services & Capabilities

- [Hardwood & LVP Flooring](https://cfsflooring.com/services/hardwood-laminate-and-lvp): Solid & engineered hardwood, 100% waterproof luxury vinyl plank, laminate, subfloor prep, and moisture mitigation.
- [Hardwood Sand & Finish Refinishing](https://cfsflooring.com/services/sand-and-finish): HEPA dust-controlled sanding, custom stain color matching, oil & water-based polyurethane, historical wood restoration.
- [Professional Carpet Installation](https://cfsflooring.com/services/carpet-installation): High-density cushion padding, power-stretching, plush residential broadloom, and modular commercial carpet tiles.
- [Ceramic Tile & Natural Stone](https://cfsflooring.com/services/ceramic-tile): Porcelain, ceramic, marble tile installation for floors, backsplashes, custom showers, and tub surrounds.
- [Sheet Vinyl Flooring](https://cfsflooring.com/services/sheet-vinyl): Seamless waterproof sheet vinyl for healthcare, kitchens, and high-moisture utility spaces.
- [Commercial VCT Flooring](https://cfsflooring.com/services/vct-flooring): High-traffic vinyl composition tile for retail stores, schools, medical facilities, and office buildings.
- [Flooring Removal & Subfloor Prep](https://cfsflooring.com/services/flooring-removal): Complete tile, hardwood, and carpet demolition, subfloor leveling, and adhesive scraping.
- [Counters & Decks](https://cfsflooring.com/services/counters-and-decks): Custom countertop installations and exterior wood/composite deck refinishing.
